statuses.Supported: available for this OpenAPI version and configuration
statuses.Partial: available with the limitations described below
statuses.Validation only: the document is checked and preserved, without a generated runtime implementation
statuses.Opt-in: requires additional configuration or an application-supplied implementation
statuses.Unsupported: not implemented; the generator reports why it cannot use this input
statuses.N/A: the capability does not apply to this OpenAPI version or generation profile

evidence.testName: typed upstream corpus cases generate, strict-compile, and execute every accounted outbound operation
evidence.description: Every pinned fixture is loaded through the public generator and strict-compiled for every declared profile.

evidence.testName: typed upstream corpus cases generate, strict-compile, and execute every accounted outbound operation
evidence.description: The artifact inventory is checked against outbound, inbound, links, component, and validation consumers.

evidence.testName: typed upstream corpus cases generate, strict-compile, and execute every accounted outbound operation
evidence.description: An explicit case table covers each normalized outbound operation and fails on new or skipped operations.

evidence.testName: typed upstream corpus cases generate, strict-compile, and execute every accounted outbound operation
evidence.description: Validation-enabled clients use the generated Ajv registry; JSON, empty, form, and binary media use native codecs.

evidence.testName: typed upstream corpus cases generate, strict-compile, and execute every accounted outbound operation
evidence.description: Callback and webhook operations are strict-compiled as inbound ports and are excluded from outbound execution counts.

evidence.testName: OpenAPI 3.2 querystring, sequential stream, and binary responses work on the wire
evidence.description: SSE frames preserve the protocol envelope including data, event, id, and retry fields.

evidence.testName: itemSchema is rejected for OpenAPI 3.1 before SDK generation
evidence.description: The itemSchema keyword is rejected before SDK generation on OpenAPI 3.1; the stream surface begins on the 3.2 feature line.

evidence.testName: generated client serializes path, repeated query, form body and API-key auth
evidence.description: Built-in parameter and body codecs are exercised with concrete wire assertions.

evidence.testName: OpenAPI 3.2 querystring, sequential stream, and binary responses work on the wire
evidence.description: Custom stream and advanced multipart codecs are tested only at their explicit media-type boundaries.

evidence.testName: typed upstream corpus cases generate, strict-compile, and execute every accounted outbound operation
evidence.description: Link Objects are generated and type-checked as metadata; no link execution claim is made.

evidence.testName: normalizes callbacks and webhooks into typed inbound contracts
evidence.description: Callbacks and webhooks are normalized into framework-neutral inbound contracts.

evidence.testName: the OpenAPI Ajv engine enforces $dynamicRef/$dynamicAnchor recursion, unevaluatedProperties, and allErrors
evidence.description: Conditional and annotation-dependent semantics remain runtime-authoritative; TypeScript inference is recorded as partial.

evidence.testName: generated content parameters validate before execute with runtime and standalone Ajv
evidence.description: Content-based querystring, query, header, and path parameters reject invalid input before serialization and do not call fetch in either validation adapter profile.

evidence.testName: parameter content false schemas remain false during normalization and are rejected before fetch
evidence.description: An explicit false schema in parameter content remains false through normalization and the emitted runtime registry, preserving the never input contract.

evidence.testName: generated SDK enforces conditional request and response schemas with runtime and standalone Ajv
evidence.description: Conditional request violations are rejected before fetch and conditional response violations are rejected after decoding in both runtime and standalone Ajv profiles.

evidence.testName: undeclared HTTPS schema refs stay blocked without network
evidence.description: Remote references are an explicit opt-in boundary with host and resource limits.

evidence.testName: typed compliance records and evidence links are unique and complete
evidence.description: Capability, profile, version, surface, status, limitation, and evidence links are validated before matrix generation.

evidence.testName: public directional projection handles repeated aliases and allOf requirements without weakening neutral or required-only schemas
evidence.description: Public generation, strict types, default Ajv, sibling allOf constraints and neutral model validation are exercised together.

evidence.testName: public resource graph distinguishes whole, scalar, and nested targets with relative resource scope
evidence.description: Public generation, strict consumer types and default Ajv agree on whole resources, URI fragments and nested relative identifiers without network access.

evidence.testName: public generate types URI $id refs, directional imports, nested models, and validation
evidence.description: HTTPS, URN and relative references retain typed request/response contracts, nested model conversion and explicit model validation.

evidence.testName: selects exact status then exact media, then type/*, then */* without status fallthrough
evidence.description: Exact/range/default status selection precedes exact/type/global media selection; codecs use the selected contract and actual wire media.

evidence.testName: decoder failures cancel an unconsumed generated response body
evidence.description: Protocol, decoder and validation failures cancel unconsumed bodies and preserve the original error; stream overrides select actual media before declared wildcards.

evidence.testName: header simple values stay literal and never percent-decode
evidence.description: Header arrays and objects preserve literal spaces and percent sequences.

evidence.testName: OAS 3.2 style cookie stringifies without URI encoding while form cookies keep encoding
evidence.description: The 3.2 cookie style differs deliberately from the legacy form cookie encoding.

evidence.testName: prefixItems unions compile in strict TypeScript and validate on default Ajv
evidence.description: Prefix-length tuple unions preserve short arrays and positional types, with runtime bounds enforced by Ajv.

evidence.testName: JSON-seq rejects truncated primitives at EOF and malformed records, cancelling the reader
evidence.description: RS framing, primitive whitespace, fatal UTF-8 and reader cleanup are tested independently of schema validation.

evidence.testName: itemSchema false emits AsyncIterable<never>; validation-on rejects the first item and validation-off still yields
evidence.description: A false item schema is present; the global profile controls schema enforcement while framing remains active.

evidence.testName: maxRefBytes ignores understated Content-Length and cancels on the first exceeding chunk
evidence.description: Received bytes are bounded during streaming, including absent or understated Content-Length.

evidence.testName: full-feature fixture compiles with noUnusedLocals for every profile
evidence.description: A strict noUnused consumer checks helper and import closure across every profile.

evidence.testName: OAS discriminator mappings select allOf variants in model decode, encode, and the shared codec
evidence.description: Explicit (reference and bare-name) and implicit mappings narrow each allOf variant to a required literal tag; model decode, nested fields and parse/stringify select the variant and reject unknown tags.

evidence.testName: discriminator-less object unions name the schema and suggest a discriminator
evidence.description: A oneOf of object models without a discriminator or const tags fails generation and names the schema.

evidence.testName: every variant must declare the discriminator property
evidence.description: A variant that does not declare the discriminator property fails generation instead of losing the tag on encode.

evidence.testName: a discriminator inherited through allOf without oneOf is reported as unsupported
evidence.description: A discriminator on a base schema without oneOf/anyOf produces a generation warning instead of silently decoding the base.

evidence.testName: generated transport honors OAS security, encoding, response, and stream rules
evidence.description: Cookie parameters and cookie API keys warn at generation and are still sent from Node; optional security, UTF-8 Basic credentials, allowReserved, nested deepObject, body-less and undeclared responses, and SSE framing are exercised on the wire.
